summary: Master the art of Business Analysis in Project Management with our comprehensive training course. Gain valuable skills to drive project success.
lede: Project management and business analysis training helps project professionals translate business needs into clear requirements and manageable scope. For project business analysts, project managers, requirements analysts, product owners and PMO professionals, it develops stakeholder elicitation, process modelling and requirements traceability. Exercises apply these methods to define acceptance criteria, assess change impacts and connect project outputs with measurable benefits.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect business needs, requirements, solutions, and project delivery decisions. It is suitable for foundation to intermediate learners who need practical business analysis in project management capabilities.
prerequisites: You need basic exposure to project work, such as project meetings, schedules, deliverables, or stakeholder coordination. No programming is required. You should be comfortable reading simple process diagrams and using standard office software. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted requirements review and automated reporting are taught at operational application and conceptual awareness levels, not technical engineering level.
